# Build How-To: Bloodstained Sneaky (Commando) Sniper

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_27_nukaknights-post-build-bloodiedcommandosniper.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build plays bloodstained (low HP, high radiation) without power armor and with automatic and single-shot rifles (explosive, as well as higher rate of fire) as well as with Relentless/Strengthening Sentinel armor.

## EQUIPMENT

***Armor**:* There are several options when it comes to armor for a Bloodstained Sneaky Sniper. Some rely on Fortifying Armor (the lower your health, the higher your damage resistance), some rely on Unyielding (your SPECIAL stats increase the lower your health), and there are also people who only rely on Stealth (Chameleon/Weightless/etc). I like to mix it up. I tried to play completely on Strength, but I always have problems with the weight, but Unyielding doesn't necessarily make sense for a sniper. That's why I've now landed on a combination of Strengthening/Unyielding/Chameleon. I play 2 parts Strengthening with AP Regeneration, Harder to Detect While Sneaking and Guardian Perk, 2 parts Unyielding and 1 Chameleon part. It's best to always try to find armor with AP regeneration and guard (15% chance to reduce damage by 75% while standing still). You need AP (action points) as a sniper, especially for the VATS. If you have a part with "Hard to detect while sneaking", that's enough. For AP regeneration it should be 2-3 parts for a good effect.

Additionally, problem-solving armor is available for silo runs.

***Weapons**:* When I play Auto Rifles, I go for Cleaners (especially Bloodstained and my Mutant 25/25 is fun too). If I'm single-shot skilling, I play Bloodstained Explo Underlever and Bloodstained Explo Gauss (alternatively, Bloodstained Gauss with 50% more critical hit damage). It is important for this build that all weapons have a silencer, so you do more damage at night and are more difficult to be detected (see Sandman perk).

If you would like to play mainly in VATS, it is best to convert your weapons to "hip precision". At the cleaner, for example I recommend a first-class bolt, adjusted extended barrel, adjusted piston, fast magazine, reflex sight and silencer.

## SKILL SET

**Strength 3**: Weapon belt at 2, first aid kit at 1

**Perception** **15**: Either all 3 points Rifleman (+Professional + Master) for single shot, or all 3 points Command (+Professional + Master). Additionally Concentrated Fire at 3, for targeted headshots. Panzerkiller is usable in most cases, but with the Queen you should only shoot with Panzerkiller when she has already landed, otherwise she may get "stuck" in the air. Without Tank Killer you can even quickly force the Queen (and normal firebeasts) to land by shooting the wings in VATS, in combination with the tormentor under luck this will cripple the wings and she will land.

**Endurance 5**: Here I use Radicool to get more load capacity. Adamantium skeleton at 3 makes the silo runs easier for me because then you don't have to kill all the robots and guns, you hardly get any damage from the problem-solving armor and you don't stagger because of the no body part damage. I include chem fanatics because this extends the duration of the chems' effect, and you can also get good buffs with chems on the sniper.

**Charisma** **2**: The Dozen Strange increases the effects of mutations, Meat Tenderizer increases the damage the target takes after you attack.

**Intelligence 8**: Nerd Rage at 3 is one of the most important "Bloodstained" perks and increases damage by 20%, +15% AP regeneration and 40 more damage resistance when health is below 20%.
